dispositions.subject: Sadiq and funded Dell package
dispositions.finding: PFF reports Sadiq57% snaps with Taylor active, 70% of 12-personnel snaps, half early-down 11-personnel snaps. Still a four-TE rotation; analyst explicitly says playing time/target rate insufficient for trusted starts.
dispositions.reason: Expanded personnel use supports the $2,800 participant thesis but not a secure floor. Dell + Concepcion for Sadiq + Boston uses all $700 remaining: +1100-400=+700, total $50,000. No fresh receiver-specific evidence supports preferring Concepcion to Boston; paying to improve one uncertain role introduces a second change. Hold is provisional, not a claim this package is inferior in expected points.
dispositions.whole_lineup: Keep $49,300/$700, six games. Alternative replaces the BUF@NYJ bring-back with another HOU@CLE player, increasing HOU@CLE exposure from one to two; removes Boston rather than adding a second CLE receiver. No target/route percentages summed across denominators.

dispositions.whole_lineup: Mahomes/Rice $12,100 retained, concentrated passing and availability risk explicit.
